mapper.select: SELECT id, title, slug, summary, content, category_id, view_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(summary, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(content, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN COALESCE(summary, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
